			effect_tooltip = {

					add_ideas = COLDWAR_AFG_gas_commission
					custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_AFG_pay_gas_commission_income_tt
					add_power_balance_value = { id = COLDWAR_AFG_bop value = -0.05 tooltip_side = COLDWAR_AFG_bop_moscow }
				}
			}
		}

			modifier = { factor = 2 has_opinion = { target = AFG value > 49 } }
			modifier = { factor = 0.25 has_opinion = { target = AFG value < -20 } }
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_war_with = AFG }
			modifier = { factor = 2 AFG = { OR = { emerging_communist_state_are_in_power = yes emerging_anarchist_communism_are_in_power = yes } } }
			modifier = { factor = 0.3 AFG = { OR = { salafist_caliphate_are_in_power = yes neutrality_neutral_muslim_brotherhood_are_in_power = yes } } }
		}
	}

		cost = 0
		days_re_enable = 180

		visible = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_limited_contingent_partner }
		available = {
			check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_AFG_contingent_level value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			country_exists = AFG
		}

		complete_effect = {
			log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: Decision COLDWAR_AFG_contingent_offensive"
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = { value = gdp_total multiply = -0.00002 } }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			add_war_support = -0.02
			army_experience = 25
			AFG = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_AFG.705 } }
			custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_AFG_offensive_afg_tt
		}

		ai_will_do = { base = 1 }
	}

	COLDWAR_AFG_contingent_withdraw = {

COLDWAR_AFG_refugees_category = {
	COLDWAR_AFG_host_refugees_pak = {
		icon = generic_civil_support
		allowed = { original_tag = PAK }

		cost = 0

		visible = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_hosting_refugees } }
		available = {
			country_exists = AFG
			custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = COLDWAR_AFG_exodus_active_tt AFG = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_refugees > 0 } } }
		}

		complete_effect = {
			log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: Decision COLDWAR_AFG_host_refugees_pak"
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_hosting_refugees
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_supporter
			add_ideas = COLDWAR_AFG_pak_refugee_host
			custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_AFG_host_refugees_pak_tt
		}

		ai_will_do = { base = 1 }
	}

	COLDWAR_AFG_host_refugees_pak_end = {
		icon = generic_break_treaty
		allowed = { original_tag = PAK }

		cost = 0

		visible = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_hosting_refugees }

		complete_effect = {
			log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: Decision COLDWAR_AFG_host_refugees_pak_end"
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_hosting_refugees
			if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_pak_refugee_host } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_AFG_pak_refugee_host }
		}

		ai_will_do = { base = 0 }
	}

	COLDWAR_AFG_host_refugees_per = {
		icon = generic_civil_support
		allowed = { original_tag = PER }

		cost = 0

			country_exists = AFG
			custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = COLDWAR_AFG_exodus_active_tt AFG = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_refugees > 0 } } }
		}

		complete_effect = {
			log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: Decision COLDWAR_AFG_host_refugees_per"
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_hosting_refugees
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_supporter
			add_ideas = COLDWAR_AFG_per_refugee_host
			custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_AFG_host_refugees_per_tt
		}

	}

	COLDWAR_AFG_host_refugees_per_end = {
